authority: independently motivated continual-learning benchmark; asks whether checkpoint measurements forecast paired future trainability on concealed Permuted-MNIST tasks; no correction construct, adaptive-complexity construct, or new theory

future_task.identity_rule: new pixel permutation drawn from a separate future-task stream after checkpoint measurements are frozen; future identity is never an input to checkpoint predictors
future_task.fresh_reference: same architecture and exact shared initial weights as the history run before continual training; trained on the identical future task and example order

definitions.delta_auc_accuracy: trapezoidal AUC(checkpoint future-task test accuracy over normalized training progress) minus matched fresh-network AUC
definitions.t90_gap_fraction: checkpoint progress fraction minus fresh progress fraction required to reach 90% of fresh final accuracy; not reached is encoded as 1.25

models.plasticity: capability plus all prospectively defined plasticity measurements

forecast.null: outer-fold training mean for each outcome

gates.G0: forecastability: rich model has lower out-of-fold RMSE than null; report bootstrap 95% interval for null-RMSE minus rich-RMSE on each primary outcome
gates.G1: current capability: capability model versus age-only
gates.G2: established plasticity measurements: plasticity model versus capability
gates.G3: broader checkpoint state: rich model versus plasticity
gates.escalation: G4 cross-family transport and any compression-specific search remain unauthorized in this benchmark pass regardless of descriptive G0-G3 outcomes

provenance.future_task_concealment: checkpoint measurements are constructed before future task permutation seeds are consumed
provenance.smoke: smoke mode uses synthetic data and a separate seed; it is development evidence only
provenance.pilot0: read-only and unrelated to this benchmark
provenance.id1: closed and not used to select benchmark outcomes or features

nonclaims: forecastability does not imply a new adaptive property
failure of the rich sketch does not prove the full checkpoint contains no predictive information
task age prediction is an ordinary temporal explanation, not a mechanism
paired plasticity loss is not correction capacity
Permuted-MNIST transport does not imply cross-domain transport
no G4-G6 claim is authorized by this pass
